cycle.note: South Carolina CPE runs by calendar year: 40 hours, 2 of them ethics. Up to 20 extra hours carry forward. The license renews every year.

requirements.label: Annual CPE
requirements.note: 40 hours each calendar year. Up to 20 hours over last year's 40 carry forward (not toward ethics).

requirements.label: Personal development
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. Personal development is limited to 20% (8 hours) a year.

requirements.label: Nano-learning
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 4 nano-learning hours a year.

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: At least 2 hours of ethics every year. Since 2022 any behavioral or regulatory ethics course counts.

newLicensee.note: No CPE is required in the year you're first licensed (and no carryover is earned that year).

licenseDateHint: South Carolina licenses renew every year. CPE is tracked by calendar year.
issueDateHint: If you were first licensed this year, no CPE is due until next year.
limitsNotTracked: Authored works: max 10 hours; college instruction: max 10; committee/technical meetings: max 16.
At most 12 hours a day; blended learning isn't accepted.
Some kinds of hours (nano, authored works, higher education) may not carry forward.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for at least 5 years from the reporting due date.
toVerify: Which kinds of hours can carry forward since the 2023 changes.
